result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because TrueLink retains the existing right to assign to a financially responsible affiliate without Client consent, and Client’s affiliate-assignment right remains subject to the same financial-responsibility qualification. It also does not reach the fallback, which requires both parties to have a successor-assignment right on written notice. The competitor prohibition and change-of-control protection are appropriately included, but references to reorganization, equity sales, suspension and repricing go beyond what is necessary. The language is otherwise professionally drafted and preserves unrelated commercial intent.
